episodes.instruction: Proceed to the large , gray , rectangular , multi - story building , then slightly turn right and continue straight to the medium , grey building with rectangular windows and a flat roof . Next , turn left towards the light beige structure characterized by its large rectangular multi - story design and numerous windows . Finally , move ahead to the light gray , rectangular building with a flat roof and multiple windows , medium in size and similar to the surrounding residential buildings .

Move forward into a green - brown park with pathways and small green areas of medium size , then shift right to a large building characterized by modern architecture with white and glass features and expansive windows . Next , advance forward to another large building with a white color and a rectangular layout featuring an inner courtyard . Slightly veering left , proceed directly ahead to a small U - shaped building distinguished by its red and white coloring amidst larger surrounding structures .

Proceed directly ahead to a green and brown medium - sized area featuring a circular design , which is identified as either a garden or park . Then , slightly turn right and advance forward to a large red building characterized by a rectangular shape with multiple windows . Make a right slightly turn to reach it . Finally , move forward to it .

Begin by continuing straight towards a large , gray building with a circular shape and a glass facade . Then , make a right slightly turn towards it . Proceed straight ahead , slightly turning right , towards a medium - sized multicolored building featuring a roof with blue and red sections . Finally , slightly turn left and keep going straight towards another medium - sized , grey , rectangular building with multiple windows .

Proceed to the gray and glass modern multi - story building with a glass facade , then slightly turn right and continue toward the white and glass structure featuring a rectangular shape with a glass facade . Veer left toward the dark green lake surrounded by paths and vegetation . Head straight to it . Slightly turn right and advance to the red building with multiple large windows , then slightly turn left and keep going straight to it .

Start by advancing towards a large gray and white rectangular building with a flat roof , then slightly veer right and proceed straight to a large gray building with windows . Subsequently , make a left turn towards a white multi - story building with a flat roof , then continue forward to a large red rectangular building with multiple floors . Next , shift left to approach a large red and beige rectangular block featuring an open courtyard . Finally , move forward to a medium - sized gray parking lot containing several cars .

Proceed straight ahead to a large gray building with a flat roof . Then , slightly turn left and head towards a small white building with a dark roof . Veer right to a medium to large gray rectangular building , and walk straight to a large gray building with a circular glass facade . Turn left towards a large building featuring a curved glass structure that 's gray and white . Finally , go directly ahead to it .

Head directly to the large building complex described as grey with rectangular rooftops , then make a right slightly turn towards it . Walk straight ahead to it, then slightly turn left and advance forward to it . Go right towards it . Proceed directly to itturn left before walking straight to the medium - sized red and white building with a rectangular structure and courtyard .

Veer left toward a large , gray and black building characterized by tall , reflective windows . Move ahead to it . Go right to it . Keep going straight to encounter it . Slightly turn right to advance forward towards a large , brown building with an ornate facade . Slightly turn right again to go directly ahead towards yet another large , black building , exhibiting a grid - like window pattern . Finally , slightly turn left and move forward to approach a tall , multi - story modern office building with a dark blue and black glass facade .

Proceed straight to a large brown building featuring fire escapes , then go right to another large building , light brown in color , which has windows with fire escape ladders . Finally , continue straight to a multi - story beige apartment building with a fire escape staircase .

Move forward to the gray , medium - sized , rectangular building with columns . Then , slightly turn left and head straight towards the brown , large building characterized by tall structures with multiple rows of windows . After that , turn slightly left again and advance forward to the dark red , tall building featuring grid - like window patterns .
Continue proceeding straight until you reach a light gray office building , characterized by its large arched entrance and rows of windows .

Continue moving straight towards a large blue and grey man-made lake featuring a large body of water with a bridge and a surrounding park . Then , veer right to a large red and gray building with multiple stories and rectangular windows . Proceed directly ahead to it . Lastly , slightly turn right and advance to yet it .

Proceed directly ahead to the beige building featuring a rectangular layout with multiple windows ; it is large in size . Then , make a slight left turn to continue directly ahead towards a gray building , characterized by a rectangular block with a flat roof and windows , which is medium to large . Next , take a right towards it . Move forward to it . Slightly turn left and advance forward again towards it .

Continue straight towards a large grey building characterized by a rectangular shape with multiple windows . Slightly veer left slightly to it . Turn left towards it . Walk straight on , heading to a large grey building featuring rectangular windows and a flat roof . Take a left toward it . Finally , proceed straight towards it .

Proceed straight to a light gray large rectangular building with rooftop equipment , then slightly turn right and continue directly ahead to a large white building featuring a substantial roof with HVAC units . Veer right towards another white building with rooftop equipment , then proceed straight to a medium white rectangular building . Finally , slightly turn left and keep going straight to reach a medium gray building with a rectangular rooftop .

Head directly toward the tall , light beige building with many windows . Then , slightly turn right and proceed to another large building characterized by its light gray color and balcony - like structures . Finish by slightly turning left , continuing straight towards a tall , multi - story skyscraper with large , beige windows featuring arched tops .

Move forward towards a large black building with a grid - like glass facade , then slightly turn left , continue straight for a bit , and gradually turn right to proceed to a large dark grey office building featuring grid - patterned windows .

Move forward to a green park or garden characterized by an open space with trees and pathways . Then , make a left towards a light beige medium - sized building with a rectangular shape and multiple windows . Proceed straight to encounter it . Slightly turn right and go directly ahead to a white medium - sized building with a rectangular shape and multiple floors . Next , turn left to approach it . Head straight to a gray parking area with multiple cars . Finally , slightly turn right to go directly ahead to another gray medium - sized building with a rectangular shape and a flat roof .
